ov: دروب المجد (الإنجليزية: Paths of Glory) هو فيلم مناهض للحرب من إخراج ستانلي كوبريك، أحداثه تدور في فترة الحرب العالمية الأولى. القصة مأخوذة من رواية دروب المجد للكاتب والروائي همفري كوب.
plotEn:
In 1916, during World War I in Northern France, French Major General Georges Broulard orders his subordinate, Brigadier General Paul Mireau, to take "the Anthill", a well-defended German position on the far side of no man's land. Mireau initially refuses, calling it impossible. When Broulard mentions a potential promotion, Mireau convinces himself the attack can succeed. In the trenches, Mireau throws a private out of the regiment for showing signs of shell shock. Mireau leaves the planning of the attack to Colonel Dax, despite Dax's protests.
Before the attack, drunken Lieutenant Roget leads a night-time reconnoiter, sending one of his two men ahead. Overcome by fear while waiting for the scout's return, Roget lobs a grenade, accidentally killing the man. Corporal Paris, the surviving scout, confronts Roget, who denies wrongdoing and falsifies his report to Colonel Dax.
The daylight attack on the Anthill is a failure. Dax leads the first wave of soldiers over the top under heavy rifle and machine gun fire, but none of them reach the German trenches and the follow up waves refuse to attack. Mireau orders his artillery to fire on them to force them onto the battlefield. The artillery commander refuses without written confirmation of the order.
To deflect blame for the attack's failure, Mireau decides to court-martial a hundred soldiers for cowardice. Broulard orders Mireau to reduce the number, and Mireau asks each company in the attacking wave to select one man. Roget picks C
